name: How long does a tile roof repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a tile roof repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a tile roof repair varies based on the extent of the damage and the size of the area needing attention. Minor repairs, such as replacing a few broken tiles, might take a few hours to a day. More extensive damage, like repairing a large leak or replacing a section of underlayment, could take several days. We provide a time estimate after a thorough inspection of your specific roof's condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on the damage extent; minor fixes take hours, while extensive repairs can take several days.
